methods.P1: Fresh same-origin iframe of ?lesson=follow-suit. Navigation timeOrigin to an enabled lesson control observed after React mounts, polled every 20 ms. This is an interactivity proxy, not a browser TTI metric. The parent has already loaded app assets: caches are NOT automatically empty. For cold-start evidence clear/disable cache and set Fast 4G manually where available; repeated samples may be warm. Internal-build overhead and polling are included.
methods.P2: One solvePosition call evaluates all legal card classes at one F2 position (SolveBoard-type). Worker-local elapsed time includes first-use WASM loading. Never divide by the number of cards.
methods.P3: Worker-local elapsed time for each full F2 table solve. F7 also solves each completed Deal's table to exercise this candidate throughout the soak; those extra solves are not mixed into the F2 distribution.
methods.P4: Real principles and Contract Choice workers through robotHost, all seats. Elapsed request-to-response latency includes worker startup and transport, excludes the fixed 500 ms display delay. Fallback latency comes from host provenance. Existing 400 ms deadline and failure threshold 3 are unchanged. Phase V robots do not use the selected solver.
methods.P5: Main-page PerformanceObserver longtask entries during the candidate run; iframe work and unrelated page work may be included. Unsupported browsers report unsupported, not zero. Statistics cover observed long tasks only.
methods.P6: Maximum observed memory sample, not an instantaneous peak. measureUserAgentSpecificMemory where available; otherwise performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize (main-page JS heap only, excludes worker/WASM memory). Unsupported or rejected APIs remain unsupported. A persisted unfinished run indicates interruption, not proof of a tab crash. Worker error events are recorded separately.
methods.samples: Two fixed seeded Contract Bridge positions after 40 legal card plays, generated by Table. sampledEstimate runs in the solver worker. Cost per layout = sum of solvePosition elapsed time / actual sampleCount; sampling overhead is excluded and total estimator time is recorded separately.
methods.visibility: New work pauses while hidden. Any timing spanning a hidden interval is excluded. Timeout and engine-failure fallbacks for a decision spanning a hidden interval are excluded and counted separately; denominator is completed Deals. The host itself pauses/restarts hidden decisions (US-43.2). No not-covered call fallbacks occur in MiniBridge.
methods.thresholds: No gate pass/fail is inferred. U-16 remains an owner decision. Small configurations are verification runs, not F7 gate evidence.
